createPage.title: Create a page
createPage.blockDescription:
Blocks are what your page is made of. You can add text, image, list, FAQ, etc.

Each block types will need different data to be displayed.

Each block will be displayed in the order you add them.

url.label: Url
url.description: The url of this page. This is where the page will be accessible from.

locale.label: Language
locale.description: The language of this page. This is the language in which the page will be displayed.

blocks.listItemRequired: At least one list item is required
blocks.faqFieldsRequired: All FAQ items need a question and answer
blocks.relatedRequired: At least one related link is required

schemas.keywordsRequired: At least one keyword is required

errors.createPageFailed: An error occurred while creating the page
errors.pageAlreadyExists: A page already exists with this URL and this language

description.name: Description
description.description: This block is used to describe a section of the page.

text.description: This block is used to add a long text to the page.

heading.name: Heading
heading.description: This block is used to add a heading to the page.

list.name: List
list.description: This block is used to add a list to the page.

image.name: Image
image.description: This block is used to add an image to the page.

faq.name: FAQ
faq.description: This block is used to add a FAQ to the page.

space.name: Space
space.description: This block is used to add a space to the page.

related.name: Related
related.description: This block is used to add related pages to the page.

space.title: Space
space.description: This block adds a space to the page.

related.title: Related pages
related.description: This block adds related pages link to the page.

SeoForm.title: SEO
SeoForm.description: This interface is used to configure the page's metadata. This allows you to personalize the title, description, keywords and image of the page. And therefore improve the page's visibility on search engines. The more information you provide, the better the page will be indexed by search engines.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleDescription: The title displayed in search engine results.
fields.descriptionDescription: A short summary shown below the title in search results.
fields.keywordsDescription: Comma-separated keywords to help search engines index this page.

schemas.title: Structured Data
schemas.description: Add structured data schemas to improve search engine understanding of your page. One schema per type.

article.name: Article
article.description: Schema for blog posts and articles.

person.name: Person
person.description: Schema for a person or author.

product.name: Product
product.description: Schema for a product or service.

token.title: Your access key
token.description: Your access keys allow you to access the Basalf CMS API. These keys must be kept secret and never shared. If you lose these keys, you will no longer be able to access the Basalf CMS API. If you share them, you could expose your account to security risks. If you lose them, contact us immediately.
